item.tib: ye srid 'phrul gyi ju thig gi mo bdar chung ba nyer mkho khyer bde
item.coloph: de ltar khrus bdar bsang gsum gyi don bsdus khyer bde logs su dgar ba 'di yang / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis bka' dang lung la gzhi byas nas/ brtsams pa la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa mi 'chab mthol bshags 'bul/ dge ba'i 'bras bu yon tan ci mchis pa/ ma rig sems can blo mun sel ba yi/ ye shes sgron me rtag tu gsal gyur cig/
